facts.statement: Petralca is an extinct genus of loon discovered in Oligocene and Miocene deposits in Austria.
facts.quote: Petralca is an extinct genus of loon found in Oligocene and Miocene deposits of Austria.

facts.statement: The only species of Petralca, Petralca austriaca, was described in 1987.
facts.quote: The type and only species, Petralca austriaca, was described in 1987.

facts.statement: Petralca is the sole member of the Petralcinae subfamily.
facts.quote: It is the only member of the Petralcinae subfamily.

facts.statement: Researchers initially considered Petralca the oldest European auk, but Göhlich and Mayr (2018) reinterpreted it as a member of Gaviiformes.
facts.quote: Originally thought to be the oldest representative of auk in Europe, it was reinterpreted as a member of Gaviiformes by Göhlich & Mayr (2018).

facts.statement: Petralca lived between 23.04 and 20.45 million years ago during the Aquitanian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Aquitanian to Aquitanian (23.04 to 20.45 million years ago)
